title: Breaking down neuroscience through deep biological interpretation
summary: You don't need to read minds to understand your neuroscience data – you need to read the biology. body_text: You don't need to read minds to understand your neuroscience data – you need to read the biology. From data generation to biological interpretation Advances in next-generation sequencing (NGS) have reshaped research on neurodevelopmental disorders. Whole-genome sequencing, RNA sequencing, single-cell transcriptomics and spatial transcriptomics now allow researchers to examine the developing nervous system at extraordinary resolution. These new, detailed datasets have created new opportunities – instead of just checking which genes show increased or decreased expression, researchers can decode the biological meaning of these changes. The only problem is the scale. A single RNA-seq study may identify hundreds or thousands of differentially expressed genes. A genome sequencing project may uncover many rare variants, including variants of uncertain significance. Single-cell studies can reveal cell type-specific changes across progenitors, neurons and glial populations. Each result is valuable, but the larger scientific task is connecting those results to plausible mechanisms. Why interpretation matters Neurological disorders such as autism spectrum disorder, Rett syndrome, fragile X syndrome, epilepsy-associated developmental disorders and intellectual disability rarely point to one simple biological explanation. Instead, diverse genetic and molecular findings often converge on shared processes, including synaptic function, neuronal development, immune signaling, chromatin regulation and cell fate decisions. Figure 1. The Autism Signaling Pathway from QIAGEN IPA. This pathway documents the known genetic and molecular mechanisms surrounding the autism spectrum disorder (ASD) phenotype. It is among the 500+ signaling pathways created by our in-house team of curation experts using information from scientific publications and reputable third-party databases. This is why biological interpretation is becoming essential in neuroscience bioinformatics. It helps researchers move from lists of genes or variants toward questions that are more useful for discovery: Which pathways appear disrupted? Which upstream regulators may explain the data? Do independent datasets point toward related mechanisms? Which findings are supported by existing biological evidence? Which hypotheses are strong enough to prioritize for validation? Case in point: Autism research beyond gene lists Recent autism research illustrates this challenge well. In a 2023 Nature study1, researchers combined cerebral organoids, CRISPR-based perturbation and single-cell transcriptomics to examine high-risk autism genes. The study identified vulnerable developmental cell states and gene regulatory modules associated with autism risk, showing how single-cell data can help connect genetic perturbations to cell type-specific biological effects. That type of study produces rich, multilayered data – and to interpret this data properly, researchers need to understand how altered genes relate to developmental timing, cell identity, molecular pathways and prior evidence from the literature. Other studies have also highlighted convergent biology in autism, including links between synaptic dysfunction, immune responses and neurotransmission-related processes2,3. Together, these findings reinforce a key point: Discovery depends not only on generating data but also on interpreting them within a broader biological framework. Connecting discovery to biological understanding As multiomic approaches become more common, the importance of interpretation will only grow. Genomics, transcriptomics, epigenomics and spatial biology each provide a different view of disease biology. The opportunity lies in connecting them. QIAGEN Digital Insights supports this approach through integrated bioinformatics solutions that help researchers analyze sequencing data, interpret molecular changes within biological pathways and networks and place findings in the context of expertly curated scientific knowledge. For researchers studying autism and other neurodevelopmental disorders, this means moving beyond data analysis alone toward more confident biological interpretation. See how integrated bioinformatics can support discovery in neurodevelopmental disorders, neurodegenerative disorders and broader neuroscience research. Trustpilot 4.9 Rating over ~1700 reviews Trustpilot is an online review platform that provides a space for customers to write and share reviews about their experiences with businesses and services. It's widely recognized for its user-generated reviews, offering consumers insights into the quality, service, and reliability of companies. The platform operates with transparency and encourages authentic feedback. Businesses cannot pay to alter or remove reviews, ensuring that the opinions shared are honest and reflective of genuine customer experiences. Trustpilot is often used by consumers to inform their decisions about where to purchase products or services, as it provides a comprehensive view of a company's reputation from the viewpoint of those who have interacted with it. In essence, Trustpilot serves as a bridge between consumers and businesses, fostering trust and promoting informed decision-making based on shared customer experiences. Facebook 4.8 Rating over ~500 reviews Facebook reviews, now known as recommendations, allow users to share their experiences with a business on its Facebook Page. Customers can either recommend or not recommend the business and include detailed narratives, photos, and videos in their feedback. These reviews are public and can influence a business's reputation since they're visible to anyone visiting the page and can also appear in news feeds, reaching a broader audience. Businesses can respond to these reviews, making them a critical part of their online customer relationship management. body_text: Get a Peek Inside the Beautiful Primary Bathrooms of Cavco Homes Published On: July 24, 2026 • 5 min read • Your primary bathroom should work hard, feel comfortable and look great with understated, yet noticeable style. Your bathroom is where the day starts, where it ends, and where you carve out a few quiet, relaxing minutes that belong entirely to you. At Cavco, our expert interior designers treat our primary bathrooms with real, intentional care – constantly tracking the latest trends in design, tile, lighting, fixtures and storage to create a space that’s as functional as it is enjoyable to be in. Take a tour through some of the most impressive primary bathrooms across Cavco’s home lineup, from thoughtfully designed single-section homes to fully customizable modular builds. What You’ll Find Inside Sinks and fixtures that make a statement Lighting designed for function and mood Walk-in showers built for comfort and style Soaking tubs that you’ll want to live in Storage solutions that keep everything neat and within reach Shop our Halo Line of homes here Sinks That Set the Tone The sink area is often the first thing you see when you walk into a primary bathroom, and in a Cavco home, it makes an impression. Vanities are designed with stylish fixtures, generous counter space and his-and-hers configurations that let two people move through their morning routines without crowding each other. For example, Cavco’s Ebony Package brings in matte black faucets, drawer pulls and hardware that create a bold, cohesive look against light countertops and cabinetry. The contrast is deliberately modern and refined. Click image to browse in full-size view -> Shop our Banner Line of homes here Find Your Floor Plan Lighting That Does More Than Illuminate Good bathroom lighting serves two important purposes: it provides bright, accurate illumination for getting ready in the morning and creates a warm, relaxing atmosphere when it’s time to wind down at the end of the day. Cavco bathrooms are designed with both in mind, using layered schemes that combine overhead fixtures with vanity lighting behind mirrors and under cabinets (where available). Some homes even offer recessed lighting in a variety of colors to create a unique look and feel. The result is a comfortable, well-lit space that works as well for a quick weekday morning as it does for a slow, quiet evening wind-down. Click image to browse in full-size view -> Shop our Ovation Line of homes here Showers Built to Impress The walk–in shower has become the centerpiece of the modern primary bathroom. Cavco’s designers have embraced this with stylish, functional designs that elevate everyday living. Frameless glass enclosures open the space visually. Large-format tile on walls and floors creates a seamless, clean look that’s as easy to maintain as it is to admire. R ainfall showerheads and bench seating turn a quick rinse into something that actual ly slows you down. Click image to browse in full-size view -> Shop our Reserve Line of homes here Soaking Tubs You’ll Never Want to Leave A freestanding soaking tub changes how a bathroom feels the moment you walk in. It says, this room is meant for more than getting ready . Cavco includes standalone garden-style tubs in select floor plans, positioned as the room’s natural focal point, with clean silhouettes that pair beautifully with a contrasting faucet finish. The result looks like something out of a luxury hotel suite and, more importantly, feels like it, too. Click image to browse in full-size view -> Shop our Discovery Line of modular homes here Storage For All the Things The most beautiful bathroom gains even more appeal when there’s great storage. In Cavco homes, storage is built into the design from the start. They feature deep vanity cabinetry with drawer configurations sized for real bathroom clutter. Open shelving offers easy access to items. Select plans provide additional dedicated storage accessible directly from the primary bath. It’s the kind of convenient and thoughtful organization that keeps the room looking as good on a busy Tuesday morning as it did the day you moved in. Click image to browse in full-size view -> Shop our Signature Line of modular homes here Find A Dealer Your Primary Bathroom Should Feel Special Explore Cavco’s manufactured homes and modular homes and the beautiful bathrooms that could be yours. The difference between a bathroom that’s fine and one that genuinely impresses comes down to the details – and that’s exactly where Cavco’s Design Innovation designers put their energy. Ready to see these in person? Find your nearest Cavco retailer or explore available floor plans online to discover which primary bathroom fits the way you live. Primary Bathroom Frequently Asked Questions Do all Cavco homes include a primary bathroom with these features? Primary bathroom features vary by floor plan and home series. Entry-level single-section homes include stylish, functional designs, while double–section and modular homes offer more expansive layouts with upgraded features. Your Cavco retailer can walk you through what’s included at every price point. What is the Ebony Package? The Ebony Package is a design package that includes striking black accents on hardware, faucets, fixtures, shower doors and the garden soaking tub. It gives your primary bathroom a modern, stylish edge that is both subtle, yet instantly attention-getting. The Ebony Package is featured in our nationally available Axis double-section home . Can I customize the primary bathroom in a Cavco home? Cavco’s modular homes offer the most flexibility, including options for layout, cabinetry, fixtures and finishes. Some double–section homes also offer design package upgrades. Talk to a Cavco retailer about what’s available for the floor plan you’re considering. Are freestanding soaking tubs available in smaller floor plans? Freestanding tubs are typically found in larger floor plans where the primary bathroom has room to accommodate them. Talk to your Cavco retailer about which floor plans include soaking tubs. What shower options does Cavco offer? Depending on the home model and market availability, Cavco offers a wide variety of walk-in showers that can include ceramic tile options, rain-style showerheads, detachable hose-style sprayers, bench seating, transom windows and much more. See your local retailer for options available in the homes near you. How do I find Cavco homes available in my area? Connect with a Cavco retailer near you. They can show you available inventory, walk you through floor plans and help you identify which features and upgrades fit your budget. title: Vertiv expands power portfolio with new compact desktop UPS for personal computing, gaming and networking devices
summary: Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today introduced the Vertiv™ PowerUPS 100 Standby Series, a new generation of compact uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems designed to help maintain continuity in distributed digital environments, and reduce the impact of unexpected power interruptions on everyday digital activity. In North America, the 120V series is available with lithium-ion and VRLA models across a range of capacities to support desktop and small office applications.
body_text: COLUMBUS, Ohio [May 5, 2026] – Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today introduced the Vertiv™ PowerUPS 100 Standby Series , a new generation of compact uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems designed to help maintain continuity in distributed digital environments, and reduce the impact of unexpected power interruptions on everyday digital activity. In North America, the 120V series is available with lithium-ion and VRLA models across a range of capacities to support desktop and small office applications. Part of Vertiv’s end-to-end portfolio supporting critical infrastructure from the data center to the edge and desktop, the Vertiv PowerUPS 100 Standby Series delivers dependable battery backup and surge protection in a sleek, space-saving design for personal computers, gaming consoles, smart home devices, wireless networks, retail point-of-sale equipment and AI PCs. "For many small businesses, retail sites and connected workspaces, a short power interruption can disrupt transactions, disconnect networks or put data at risk,” said Ramesh Menon, vice president of IT systems solutions at Vertiv. “The Vertiv PowerUPS 100 Standby Series is designed to make dependable power protection easier to deploy where space, budget and simplicity matter — from desktops and workstations to point-of-sale systems and essential network devices.” The UPS includes up to eight outlets with a combination of battery backup and surge protection, allowing users to safeguard multiple critical devices simultaneously. Integrated USB-A and USB-C ports provide convenient charging for mobile devices, while the compact, wall-mountable design enables flexible placement in space-constrained environments. The series also prioritizes long-term usability and system management. User-replaceable batteries help extend product lifespan and reduce maintenance costs, while compatibility with Vertiv™ Power Assist software enables automated, graceful shutdown of connected systems during extended outages to help protect against data loss and equipment damage. Featuring four VRLA models ranging from 500VA / 305W to 1100VA / 670W, as well as two lithium-ion in 350VA / 210W and 400VA / 240W, the Vertiv™ PowerUPS 100 Standby Series offers capacity options for a range of applications. The series is also certified to Energy Star 2.0 requirements, Department of Energy (DOE) efficiency standards, and FCC Part 15 Class B regulations. Models are available with a connected equipment protection plan and are backed by a three-year warranty for Valve-Regulated Lead-Acid (VRLA) configurations and a five-year warranty for lithium-ion models, providing reliable power protection for critical electronics. For more information about the Vertiv PowerUPS 100 series and Vertiv’s end-to-end portfolio of power and thermal management solutions that extend from the desktop to the edge, visit Vertiv.com . About Vertiv Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extends from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv does business in more than 130 countries. For more information, and for the latest news and content from Vertiv, visit Vertiv.com . title: Cosmos Health Share Buyback Expands to 5.11 Million Shares; Continues Open Market Repurchases
summary: Cosmos Health has now repurchased a total of 5,112,000 shares for approximately $1.11 million....
body_text: CHICAGO, July 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cosmos Health Inc. ("Cosmos Health" or the “Company”) (NASDAQ:COSM) , a diversified, vertically integrated global healthcare group, today announced that it has repurchased an additional 274,000 shares of its common stock in the open market at an average price of approximately $0.2554 per share. The Company has now repurchased a total of 5,112,000 shares for approximately $1.11 million under its previously announced share repurchase program of up to $5 million. Under the program, Cosmos Health may repurchase shares from time to time in the open market, through privately negotiated transactions, or through other permitted means, in accordance with SEC Rules 10b5-1 and 10b-18 and other applicable rules and regulations. The Company intends to continue making open market repurchases, subject to market conditions, under the program, which expires on December 31, 2026, and may be renewed at the Company’s sole discretion. Greg Siokas, CEO of Cosmos Health, stated: "Reaching over five million shares repurchased underscores our continued commitment to the program and our belief that the Company’s shares remain undervalued relative to the strength and potential of our business.” About Cosmos Health Inc. Cosmos Health Inc. (Nasdaq:COSM), incorporated in 2009 in Nevada, is a diversified, vertically integrated global healthcare group. The Company owns a portfolio of proprietary pharmaceutical and nutraceutical brands, including Sky Premium Life®, Mediterranation®, bio-bebe®, C-Sept® and C-Scrub®. Through its subsidiary Cana Laboratories S.A., licensed under European Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and certified by the European Medicines Agency (EMA), it manufactures pharmaceuticals, food supplements, cosmetics, biocides, and medical devices within the European Union. Cosmos Health also distributes a broad line of pharmaceuticals and parapharmaceuticals, including branded generics and OTC medications, to retail pharmacies and wholesale distributors through its subsidiaries in Greece and the UK. Furthermore, the Company has established R&D partnerships targeting major health disorders such as obesity, diabetes, and cancer, enhanced by artificial intelligence drug repurposing technologies, and focuses on the R&D of novel patented nutraceuticals, specialized root extracts, proprietary complex generics, and innovative OTC products. Cosmos Health has also entered the telehealth space through the acquisition of ZipDoctor, Inc., based in Texas, USA. With a global distribution platform, the Company is currently expanding throughout Europe, Asia, and North America, and has offices and distribution centers in Thessaloniki and Athens, Greece, and in Harlow, UK. More information is available at www.cosmoshealthinc.com , www.skypremiumlife.com , www.cana.gr , www.zipdoctor.co , www.cloudscreen.gr , as well as LinkedIn and X .
